title: Tenure Reduction of the Assisted Living Apartment Transfer Fee
content:
**Rate note — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.** Larkspur tenure lowers the apartment transfer fee. Tenure is the number of whole months from the date the resident's Larkspur tenure starts, a date fixed by how the resident came to assisted living, up to the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the starting date.

| Larkspur tenure on the handling date | Share of the transfer fee |
|---|---|
| At least 60 whole months | 0.8 |
| At least 24 but under 60 whole months | 0.9 |
| Under 24 whole months | No reduction under this note |

The share multiplies the transfer fee before it is rounded once to the cent.

### Boundaries (hypothetical tenure starting 10 March 2021)

| Handling date | Whole months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 9 March 2026 | 59 | 0.9 |
| 10 March 2026 | 60 | 0.8 |
| 9 March 2023 | 23 | No reduction |
| 10 March 2023 | 24 | 0.9 |
